## Updraft 0.7.8

- **Improved: Updraft's folders now carry the Updraft name.** The first time 0.7.8 starts, it renames its old "wisper-clone" folders to "updraft", and "Wisper Clone Meetings" becomes "Updraft Meetings". Your settings, history, meetings and speech models stay right where they were, just under the new name. Nothing is copied or deleted. If a folder is busy, Updraft keeps using the old one and tries again next start.
- **Improved: the last of the old name is gone from inside the app.** Behind the scenes, everything is now called Updraft. Your "start with Windows" setting, last open page and dismissed tips stay as they were.
